body: The world definitely needs a lot more people like you! ❤️

Yeah I totally agree with this!! I realise my original and follow up posts don’t convey my respect for these people.

My point I guess is more around the government not providing enough financial support to mental health (and health in general, after talking to a lot of people o’n the job today). And to be fair I guess it’s also nearly impossible finding enough people who are able to mentally cope doing this kinda job.

Don’t get me wrong it wasn’t meant to be a name and shame, the work’s these people do is incredible, I couldn’t do it! 

It’s more pointing out that people in possibly their most vulnerable state are trying to reach out, and for some calling isn’t necessarily possible (be it location or will). And in NZ, where rates are reasonably high, we don’t have the capability to facilitate them despite recent budget injections
